right_renal_hilum.name: Right renal hilum (centre of the convex-hull lid over the renal sinus)
right_renal_hilum.derived: area centroid of the 19 convex-hull facets of baked 'right_kidney' whose centres lie > 4 mm from the kidney surface (the lid over the renal sinus)

left_renal_hilum.name: Left renal hilum (centre of the convex-hull lid over the renal sinus)
left_renal_hilum.derived: area centroid of the 26 convex-hull facets of baked 'left_kidney' whose centres lie > 4 mm from the kidney surface (the lid over the renal sinus)

right_kidney_upper_pole.name: Upper pole of the right kidney
right_kidney_upper_pole.derived: baked 'right_kidney' vertex with the largest y

right_kidney_lower_pole.name: Lower pole of the right kidney
right_kidney_lower_pole.derived: baked 'right_kidney' vertex with the smallest y

left_kidney_upper_pole.name: Upper pole of the left kidney
left_kidney_upper_pole.derived: baked 'left_kidney' vertex with the largest y

left_kidney_lower_pole.name: Lower pole of the left kidney
left_kidney_lower_pole.derived: baked 'left_kidney' vertex with the smallest y
